verse.verse_1: By the fig and the olive,
verse.verse_3: And by this land made safe;
verse.verse_4: Surely We created man of the best stature
verse.verse_5: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
verse.verse_6: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
verse.verse_7: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?
verse.verse_8: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
